lines: Ahem! Citizens of Galaxity! Oh, it's you, {player}. Hi! I've been practising.
Tonight's campaign stop is the castle school. Every future voter goes to school! Well, every future voter's little brother, anyway.
Come with me? Well, not with me. I'll meet you there. I'm faster on skates.
Dash says there are schematics up there too. One on the hill path, one in the school garden. Vote Rex! Sorry. Habit.
Ah! A new citizen! Rex, future mayor of Galaxity. And yes, I'm a husky. For now. It's a long story with a lot of paperwork.
Dash says you need to learn to skate. Excellent. Every great citizen skates. It's in my plans for the town.
Citizen! Have you heard? The Gloop King is holding court in the west fields again. Past the Market.
Pop him and you'll be the talk of the town. Possibly a statue. I'll put it on my list.
{player}! Citizen! I've been thinking. Deeply. Like a mayor.
Since I got stuck in this husky body, I've noticed things. Nobody lets dogs in the bubble bath. Nobody asks dogs what they think about ANYTHING.
When I was a person I never even thought about it. Now I think about it all day. Usually while scratching my ear.
I'm writing a Doggie Bill of Rights. For Rook, and every dog in Galaxity. Will you help me?

choice.text: Dogs deserve rights. Let's do it!
lines: I KNEW you'd say that. Good citizen. Very good citizen. Let's write it!
The fight for justice can wait a little. Not long, though. My ear's itchy.
Rule one is easy: DOGS ARE WELCOME EVERYWHERE. Shops, the castle school, the Town Hall. Everywhere.
But rule two... I need your help. What's the most important thing a dog should be allowed to do?
The right to zoomies! Running in circles for no reason at all. Beautiful.

choice.text: A turn in the magic bubble bath.
lines: The right to bubbles! Rook's going to love that. I'M going to love that.
The right to sniff! Every lamp post, every flower, every new friend. Yes!
(Rex writes it down very carefully, holding the pen in his mouth.)
Done! Now we need names. Lots of names. Get Dash, Bramble, Pip and Nina to sign it. And Rook! A paw print counts.
How are the signatures coming? Dash, Bramble, Pip, Nina and Rook's paw. Every name makes it stronger!
Five names! It's ready. Let's take it to Mr. Palmer's window at the Town Hall. In the morning or daytime: he gets grumpy after teatime.

rotate: Did you see the sign by the fountain? DOGS WELCOME! I wrote that. With my mouth. It took nine tries.
Rook drank from the doggy fountain for twenty minutes. He's so proud. Then he had to go to the toilet for twenty minutes.
When I get my body back, I'm keeping the Bill of Rights. Some things you learn as a husky, you don't want to forget.

lines: Psst. {player}. Can you keep a secret? A mayor-sized secret?
Dash and I have a lab. In a shed past his house. It's a very scientific shed.
Where we come from, everyone runs experiments. That's how I ended up a husky. And how all three of us ended up here.
I think I've worked out how to switch back! I just need a helper. One with hands. And a watch.
EXCELLENT! Meet me at the lab: the shed in the yard past Dash's house. Look for the sign.
(It's on your map now. Press {map} to look.)
That's okay. A good mayor is patient. I'm practising. Again. Come and find me when you're ready.
The lab's still there, you know. Behind Dash's house. The Swap-o-Tron isn't going to pull its own lever.
YES! See you at the lab. Look for the sign!
Patient. Very patient. Extremely patient mayor.
Welcome to the lab! Mind the cables. And the beakers. And Dash.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Hi {player}! Don't touch the big lever.

lines: This is the Swap-o-Tron. Back home, in the furthest future, I built one to swap with Rook for a day. Just for fun!
But at that exact same moment, Dash ran HIS experiment...

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: ...a time one. And WHOOSH. All three of us landed here. Me in my body, Rex in Rook's, and Rook in Rex's.

lines: And here, it won't swap back. We think it needs a push from time itself. Little bits of broken time: time ripples.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: And please don't ask us about the future. Talking about it makes more ripples. Messy ones.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Your watch can feel ripples, though. Hold still a sec...

lines: (Dash taps your watch with a tiny screwdriver. It gives a little hum.)

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: There! When it hums, a ripple's near. Follow the pink pointer on its rim. We need three.

lines: Press {check_watch} to check your watch any time. Go, go, go! Future mayor's orders!

rotate: Three time ripples! Your watch's pink pointer knows the way. Mine just points at snacks.
Ripples wobble about a bit, like jelly. Very scientific jelly. Grab them with your watch!

lines: Three ripples! You're brilliant. Now the hard part.
Rook has to get in the other pod. He doesn't like the lab. Last time his fur went curly for a week.
Go and find him. Be persuasive! Like a campaign manager.
We're in! Rook's in the other pod. Dash found him a ball, so he's happy.
When you're ready, pull the big lever on the console. For science! And for democracy!
(Rex blinks. He looks down at his paws.)
Woof! ...WOOF? Why did I just say woof?
(Everyone stares at Rook.)

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Whoa! For one second, it swapped your VOICES!

lines: So close! My own voice! Did you hear how mayoral it sounded?

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Look at the reading, though. The swap's all knotted up in the Shift itself. In the crack our experiments made.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: So to undo it, we'd have to fix the crack first. And fixing that is... a much bigger job.

lines: (For a moment Dash looks very far away. Then he grins.)

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Next time. We'll get you back, Rex. Promise.

lines: Then it's settled. Science continues! {player}, you're officially our lab assistant. Here: these were mine.
(Rex hands you a pair of brass goggles with pink lenses. They smell a bit like husky.)

rotate: I've been practising my speech in my own voice. Well, my own voice in my head. It's very good.
The lab's always open for you, lab assistant. Just don't pull the lever without me.

lines: Ah, a citizen! Hello! Rex, future mayor of Galaxity, at your service.
{player}: A talking husky?
Technically I'm Dash's twin. I'm just borrowing a husky right now. It's a long story with a lot of paperwork.
{player}: Wait... aren't you Rook?
I'm REX! He's the dog! ...Even though he's the one with hands right now.
My favorite voter! You already gave me your vote... so now I need something even bigger.
{player}: Bigger than a vote?
A CAMPAIGN MANAGER! Someone to help me find out what the whole town needs.
YES! Campaign Manager {player}! I'll make you a badge. A big one.
First job: find out what Galaxity needs. Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip... and Rook. Even if he only says woof.
(Press {quest_log} to see the quest log.)
That's okay! A good mayor is patient. I'm practicing.
Citizen! Every great mayor needs a great team.
Right now my team is me. And a lamp post. The lamp post isn't very chatty.
Will you be my campaign manager?
YES! Campaign Manager {player}! I'll make you a badge. A big one.
First job: find out what Galaxity needs. Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip... and Rook. Even if he only says woof.
(Press {quest_log} to see the quest log.)
That's okay! A good mayor is patient. I'm practicing.
Changed your mind about being my campaign manager? The badge is still available. It's very shiny.
YES! Campaign Manager {player}! I'll make you a badge. A big one.
First job: find out what Galaxity needs. Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip... and Rook. Even if he only says woof.
(Press {quest_log} to see the quest log.)
Patience! I'm getting really good at it.
How's the asking going, Campaign Manager?
Remember: Dash, Bramble, Pip and Rook. Pip only comes out in the evenings, to look at the lamps.
Rook will probably just say woof. Write it down anyway. Every voice counts!
Campaign Manager! What did everyone say?
{player}: Dash wants a bike lane all the way round the lake.
Zoom zoom! Love it.
{player}: Bramble wants flowers in every window box.
Pretty! And they smell nice!
{player}: Pip wants more lamps, so nobody's scared of the dark.
Oh. That's a really good one.
{player}: And Rook said... 'Woof.'
(Rex thinks very hard.)
Hmm. What kind of woof?
{player}: A sunny, sleepy, a-little-bit-waggy woof. I think he means more naps in the sun.
See? Even a grumbly woof is an idea!
{player}: Wait. Which one of you is the dog again?
I'm REX! He's the dog!
...Even if I'm the one with the tail right now. Long story. Lots of paperwork.
Okay! Bike lanes, flowers, lamps and naps. I'll paint posters tonight. Come back tomorrow and help me hang them!
Painting posters! I've got paint on my paws. And my ears. And somehow my tail.
Come back tomorrow, Campaign Manager!
The posters are ready! Fresh and only a little bit smudgy.
One for the signpost west of the Market, one for the signpost by the dock, one for the signpost by the Homes gate...
...and one for the noticeboard in the Market Square, right where everybody walks by!
Citizens of Galaxity! Thank you for coming!
(A few people stop to listen. A pigeon listens too.)
I'm Rex, and I want to be your mayor! Bike lanes! Flowers! Lamps! And naps in the sun!
(Rex leans over and whispers.) Campaign Manager, I need a big finish. What do I say?

choice.text: Every voice counts, even the small ones!
lines: EVERY VOICE COUNTS! Even the small ones! ESPECIALLY the small ones!
(Everybody claps. The pigeon coos.)
MORE BRAIN BREAKS! For everybody! Even grown-ups!
(Everybody cheers. Somebody takes a brain break right away.)

choice.text: Vote Rex, the one who's NOT the dog!
lines: VOTE REX! I'm the one who's NOT the dog!
(Everybody laughs. Somewhere far away, Rook grumbles.)
That went GREAT! Tomorrow we take my ideas straight to Mr. Palmer. He's the mayor right now.
The big speech is this evening, at the Market Square fountain! Between 5 and 9 o'clock!
I've been practicing on the Town Hall. It hasn't clapped yet.
Tomorrow we go and see Mr. Palmer! He's the mayor right now. A very busy, very nice mayor.
I'm not nervous. My tail is just wagging for exercise.
Can you knock on Mr. Palmer's window? It's the lit one at the front of the Town Hall, with the flower box.
I'd go myself, but my tail wags too hard when I'm nervous. I'd knock over the flowers.
Well? What did Mr. Palmer say? Am I mayor? Is there a parade?
{player}: He said no. Not this year.
(Rex's ears droop.)
Oh.
{player}: But he loved your ideas. He said a good mayor is patient, and listens to everybody first.
{player}: And he said you've already started. You asked the whole town. Even Rook!
(Rex's tail starts wagging again. Slowly at first. Then very, very fast.)
I did, didn't I? Dash, Bramble, Pip... even a grumbly woof!
Maybe being mayor isn't about big speeches. Maybe it's about listening.
Then I'll keep listening. And one day... Future Mayor Rex!
{player}: Future Mayor Rex. I like it.
This is for you, Campaign Manager. My very best sash. Thank you for listening with me.

rotate: Future Mayor Rex, on listening duty! What's on your mind, citizen?
{player}: More brain breaks.
Writing it down. In my heart. And on a poster.
Mr. Palmer put flowers in the window boxes! Bramble's idea! I'm so proud of this town.
You look great in that sash, Campaign Manager!
{player}: Thanks, Future Mayor Rex.
Hee hee. Say it again.
{player}: Future Mayor Rex.

lines: The portal is open! As your future mayor, I'd like to remind everyone:
No jumping into portals after bedtime. Or before bedtime. Just... ask a grown-up first.
Citizens of Galaxity! Vote Rex! More parks! More snacks!
{player}: Who are you talking to?
The Town Hall. It's a practice speech. The Town Hall is a very good listener.
Morning laps around Nina's house! A future mayor has to know every neighborhood.
Even the ones with a giant red bow on top.
Evening skate! A mayor has to stay in shape. And go wheeee.
A good mayor never sleeps.
(Rex yawns a big husky yawn.)
...A good mayor has naps. Lots of naps.
Good morning, citizen! Today's plan: more parks, more snacks, and more brain breaks!
{player}: Here's to more brain breaks!
That's going on a poster.
My favorite voter! I'm putting your name on a park bench. A small one. Very official.

rotate: My big promise: a skate ramp on every corner.
And a water bowl on every corner. For... other people. Not me. Definitely not me.
Can I count on your vote, citizen?

lines: Wonderful! Here's to more brain breaks!
It's when everybody gets a say. Even small people. ESPECIALLY small people.
I'm REX! HE'S the dog! I'm the one with the speeches!

rotate: Someone called me Rook again today.
{player}: Oh no.
I'm REX! He's the dog! I'm making badges. Big ones.
